reference.text: Hallo! Schau mal, das ist die Kuh. Die Kuh macht Muh und frisst ganz viel Gras auf der Wiese.
reference.design: A cheerful, lively female storyteller speaking German, bright and playful with a smile in her voice, enthusiastic but not shouting, clear and friendly for small children. Designed with Qwen/Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-1.7B-VoiceDesign; no real person.
